affected_boundaries: sprint execution state to campaign runnable projection

observed_behavior: Reviewed, approved IN_PROGRESS V3 sprints with pending ready tasklets disappeared from campaign runnable-plans, suppressing continuation of retained workers.
expected_behavior: Existing started sprints remain eligible for continuation under the same approval, review, dependency and tasklet-readiness gates.
causal_mechanism: The census projected tasklets only from the PENDING-only sprint-start selector, using readiness to start as readiness to execute.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A lifecycle-transition predicate is reused as a current-state work-eligibility predicate.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The successful start transition removes the work from the eligibility set before its remaining tasklets are completed.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A started sprint with eligible remaining work must remain runnable without being reset or bypassing its gates.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Campaign selection uses a canonical runnable selector prioritizing IN_PROGRESS V3 sprints; both start and resume share one approval, review and dependency predicate. The start selector and historical V1/V2 behavior remain unchanged.

applicability_conditions: The approved reviewed sprint has immediately runnable pending tasklets
known_non_matches: Planning-only, unreviewed and all-DONE tasklet sets remain excluded
An unfinished execution dependency remains an invalid advanced sprint
confirmation_evidence: The real CLI regression failed with an empty runnable list after changing only the sprint execution state to IN_PROGRESS
All 53 focused selector and orchestration tests passed after the repair
The IPG campaign query returned all six reconciliation plans with their original T177 tasklets after the repair
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: runnable-plans joins satisfied plan dependencies with nonempty canonical tasklet readiness
tests/ready-sprints.test.js: V3 runnable selection resumes the started sprint without relaxing start or review gates
